description: Turn-boundary Stop hook for the cross-session mailbox wake (asks the model to drain unread mail when this session's own WS_MAILBOX inbox has any queued), and a SessionStart(compact) hook that nudges a compacted lead to run lead-revive before anything else. Claude Code auto-discovers this file by its hooks/hooks.json path; there is no plugin.json pointer to it (contrast the Codex adapter, whose manifest names its hooks file explicitly).
